data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Laros' meaning 'laurel'. In ancient Greece, laurel was associated with the god Apollo and was symbolic of victory and glory. The tree is also described as having 'the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations'. The name Larisa can be seen as a reminder of the victory of God's love and the healing power of the tree of life.
